title: Actual twisted-pullback reduction transport
statement: Fix finite-field datum D of characteristic p, ell≠p, finite E/Q_ell, separated finite-type schemes X,Y over its algebraic closure and a smooth f=j≫p of pure relative dimension d, with j open and p proper. Use the strict tower coordinates, Tate lines and canonical comparisons of [def-sp-purity-reduction-comparisons] and the finite origins of [det-sp-tower-gluing]. For every unnormalized uniform constructible finite-Tor tower K and m≤n, there exist the root-generator-normalized coefficient line comparison e from ell^(n+1) to ell^(m+1) [def-pur-finite-smooth-coefficient-arrows] and an ordinary-etale arrow r from scalar extension of the retained n-origin to the retained m-origin. Under reductionSiteScalarIso and the two origin comparisons, r equals the actual reduction of K. Scalar extension of sourceComparison(n), followed by the actual reduction of pullbackTower(K), equals the site/scalar comparison followed by reductionSite of pullbackTwistComparison(e) and puritySource(r), then sourceComparison(m). These are precisely the two equations in the attached Lean statement. Neither normalization of K nor flatness of the quotient is assumed.

source.place: (3), actual pullback and exceptional reductions and coefficient compatibility

proof.text: Construct the root power map and its scalar/root-generator-normalized line comparison. Use full faithfulness on the bounded ordinary origins to transport the actual input reduction, producing r and its defining equation. On K-flat representatives the coefficient adjoint of the pullback/tensor transition sends x tensor b to b times the pulled-back transition of x, with the same root power map. Canonical scalar, pullback, tensor and shift comparisons identify the two adjoints. Derive and insert the realization counit and evaluation comparisons; naturality and triangle identities give the displayed source reduction equation. This works for nonflat quotients and does not invert r.
